analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold but remains in neutral territory, and while MACD histogram shows improvement, a trend reversal is not yet confirmed. The 5-day low has been maintained, showing recovery signals, but the price is consolidating near the 20-day moving average ($38.53) resistance.

analysis.riskNote: ADX 40.3으로 뚜렷한 추세가 형성되어 있으나, -DI가 +DI보다 높아 하락 압력이 우위에 있다. 20일 이동평균선 돌파 실패 시 재차 하락 가능성이 있다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: ADX at 40.3 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is higher than +DI, suggesting downward pressure is dominant. Failure to break the 20-day moving average could lead to further decline.
analysis.continuity: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판독이 이어지고 있다. RSI는 과매도 구간을 탈출하며 개선세를 보였으나, 20일 이동평균선 저항에 막혀 여전히 횡보 구간에 머물러 있어 관망세를 유지한다.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. RSI has shown improvement exiting oversold, but remains in a sideways range blocked by the 20-day moving average resistance, thus maintaining the wait-and-see stance.
